_doc: PATV cosmetics catalog (cosmetics.js). Keep ids stable - owned copies point at them. price is PAT in Pepe's shop (0 = not sold). source: shop | achievement | level | drop | season. unlock gives it free on an achievement id (achievements.json) or a level. season items sell only between from and to (UTC dates, to exclusive). drop_weight = relative odds in Pepe's game drops; drop_events limits an item to those drops (bounty = only from completed bounties, never heists/arena/bingo). item tags (see the tags map) drive the shop filters; kink items are tagged so viewers can hide them, and never drop at random. style is render data per kind; gtf_* items are layers of the pixel avatar (style.layer). 1.99ads (S1 Q5a): avatar rings (style.ring), profile borders (style.border) and banners (style.banner) are structured fields, never CSS - cosmeticstyle.js documents them, writes v1's CSS from them and turns every item into the chat hub's structured look.
